about: Opponent thrown spells for live_ppo/spell_flight.py: sightings of the sprite from its first one (pts: [s since first sighting, box centre x, y in detector tiles]; r3 detector at conf >= 0.1 on ~12 Hz frames; live runs: their recorded ~11 Hz frames), where it landed (truth, detector tiles) and when (impact, s since first sighting). truth_from: goblins = median ground point of the Goblins the barrel dropped (their first 0.3 s; first seen 0.12 s after the labelled impact on live match 2), explosion = centre of the Fireball's first explosion box, flight-fit = the landing point of the whole-flight fit (Giant Snowball: no independent mark; on the held-out throws it is spell_flight.estimate over all sightings, so the error against it only says how early the estimate settles). kind: live = runs/live/20261120-093139 and -185026, train = ten training videos (both are what FIT was fitted on), heldout = held-out videos uVf1EUszTIM, iVgmnDX-GPY, QD_1suWFNKo (reported only, never fitted or tuned on). evolved: the sightings read goblin-barrel-ev1 (two barrels, no estimate).
